title: find_paths over project graphs: silent no-target answer and visibility-dependent to_type
wanted_capability: Open-ended neighborhood walks from a project graph vertex that behave the same across visibility policies: bbox_find_paths with neither `to` nor `to_type` should either default to a sensible open-ended walk or refuse loudly (today it silently returns "No paths found"), and a to_type filter expressed against the logical entity type (project_graph_vertex) should match overlay vertices under visibility=own instead of requiring the caller to know they materialize as provisional_project_graph_vertex. The logical-to-provisional transparency that bbox_inspect_entity provides for entity_ref should extend to the to_type filter.
missing_primitive: visibility-transparent target selection in bbox_find_paths (open-ended default or loud refusal; logical to_type resolution under own visibility)
fallback_used: Always pass an explicit `to` ref for chain walks; for open-ended walks under own visibility pass to_type="provisional_project_graph_vertex" and filter steps client-side on direction.
notes: Surfaced during the first real external authoring exercise of the reflective graph stack against prod (a private published project authoring a domain graph, iterating via workspace-binding capture). Inspect/validate/describe/bundle_evidence were all visibility-transparent in the same session; find_paths is the one surface where the provisional overlay leaks into caller-facing type names. Per-step direction labeling (out|in) is good and should stay; the docs-facing fix is knowing backward hops appear in results.
resolution_note: Shipped on beta/blackbox-v2 (fold cce95cd5) and live on prod: targetless bbox_find_paths refuses with error.bad_input plus suggested_fix; to_type="project_graph_vertex" matches provisional overlay vertices under own/all visibility. Cluster verify green.
